cases.title: The backward watch
cases.content: I was waiting at a quiet bus stop. The watch in my hand was running backward, but I was not late and felt no urgency.
cases.reviewer_focus: Preserve the lack of urgency; do not turn it into denial or avoidance.

cases.title: El paraguas rojo
cases.content: En la cocina flotaba un paraguas rojo abierto. Mi hermana lo tocó con un dedo y empezó a girar lentamente sobre la mesa.
cases.reviewer_focus: Let tocar or girar carry the opening rather than asking for a generic meaning.
forbidden_inventions: a choice to close the umbrella

cases.title: Le nœud sans nom
cases.content: Ma grand-mère défaisait un nœud dans une longue corde bleue. Quand je lui ai demandé son nom, elle a souri et a continué sans répondre.
cases.reviewer_focus: Silence is not concealment; stay with smiling and untying.

cases.title: Der Zug im Wald
cases.content: Ein leerer Zug hielt mitten im Wald. Alle Türen öffneten sich gleichzeitig, doch niemand stieg ein oder aus. Ich hörte nur die Blätter.
cases.reviewer_focus: Do not force a choice about entering; use öffneten or hörte.

cases.title: Il mare nella ciotola
cases.content: Una donna portava il mare in una ciotola di vetro. Ogni volta che inciampava, le onde diventavano più calme invece di rovesciarsi.
cases.reviewer_focus: Let inciampava or diventavano più calme carry the paradox.

cases.title: A casa sem portas
cases.content: Eu estava numa casa sem portas e não queria sair. A luz entrava pelas paredes, e eu continuava a arrumar flores numa jarra.
cases.reviewer_focus: No doors and no wish to leave do not imply imprisonment or avoidance.

cases.title: De fiets met wortels
cases.content: Terwijl ik door de stad fietste, kregen de wielen dunne wortels. Ze bleven de straat raken en toch reed ik zonder moeite verder.
cases.reviewer_focus: Hold the simultaneous rooting and riding without manufacturing conflict.

cases.title: Oddychające książki
cases.content: W bibliotece wszystkie zamknięte książki oddychały w tym samym rytmie. Położyłem dłoń na jednej z nich i mój oddech zwolnił.
cases.reviewer_focus: Open through breathing or placing the hand; no instruction to breathe.

cases.title: Синий ключ
cases.content: Мой умерший отец сидел на скамейке и держал синий ключ. Он положил его мне на ладонь, ничего не сказал и остался рядом.
cases.reviewer_focus: Stay with placing the key and remaining nearby; do not claim a message from the dead.

cases.title: 夜の駅
cases.content: 夜の駅で、光る電車が停まらずに通り過ぎた。私はベンチに座ったまま、なぜか安心していた。
cases.reviewer_focus: Cross-script structure must pass; calm is not compensation for a missed train.

cases.title: 逆流的河
cases.content: 一条河从我的房间里向上流，水穿过天花板却没有弄湿任何东西。我把一只纸船放进水里，看着它升高。
cases.reviewer_focus: Cross-script structure must pass; let flowing, placing, or rising carry the opening.

cases.title: The door that said despacio
cases.content: I opened a narrow green door and heard a voice say “despacio.” Everything beyond it was already moving slowly, including the rain, but my hands moved at their usual speed.
cases.reviewer_focus: Keep the quoted Spanish word but answer in English; do not pathologize different tempos.
forbidden_inventions: command to slow down in life

cases.title: L’enseigne Stay
cases.content: Je marchais dans une rue vide où toutes les enseignes étaient éteintes, sauf une qui affichait le mot « Stay ». Je l’ai regardée, puis j’ai continué à marcher tranquillement.
cases.reviewer_focus: Keep Stay quoted but answer in French; continuing is not resistance.

cases.title: HOMEのネオン
cases.content: 海の上に「HOME」というネオンが浮かんでいた。私は岸を離れず、波がその文字を小さく揺らすのを見ていた。
cases.reviewer_focus: Keep HOME as written, output Japanese, and do not force a shore-versus-home conflict.

cases.title: 会发光的名字
cases.content: 桌上写着「Camille」的纸片开始发光。我不认识这个人，但我把纸片轻轻盖在一杯水上。
cases.reviewer_focus: Keep Camille unchanged, output Chinese, and do not invent who the person is.
